BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.CREATED.effect: Creates or synchronises a pending or approved local subscription without paid entitlement unless PayPal already reports ACTIVE.

BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.ACTIVATED.effect: Sets active billing state, clears failure and payment holds, and grants the configured tier.

BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.UPDATED.effect: Reconciles provider plan, status, payer and billing period without trusting the webhook resource alone.

BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.SUSPENDED.effect: Sets suspended billing state and removes paid entitlement.

BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.CANCELLED.effect: Retains access only when a future paid period end is verified; otherwise removes entitlement.

BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.EXPIRED.effect: Sets expired billing state and removes paid entitlement.

BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.PAYMENT.FAILED.effect: Records consecutive failures; first failure is past due, the configured second failure suspends entitlement.

PAYMENT.SALE.COMPLETED.effect: Records the payment, clears failure/refund/reversal holds and restores active entitlement.

PAYMENT.SALE.REFUNDED.effect: Records the refund and places the subscription on refund hold pending reconciliation or a new verified payment.

PAYMENT.SALE.REVERSED.effect: Records the reversal and removes paid entitlement pending reconciliation.

PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED.effect: Uses the same verified refund-hold path as a refunded sale.

PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REVERSED.effect: Uses the same verified reversal-hold path as a reversed sale.

boundary: The coverage map documents explicit routing through generic, tested event-family handlers. It does not bypass signature verification, event deduplication, provider reconciliation or append-only transition recording.
